books.title: Normal People
books.author: Sally Rooney
books.synopsis: Connell and Marianne grow up in the same small Irish town, he a popular schoolboy and she an isolated outsider, and begin a secret relationship. Over the following years at Trinity College Dublin they drift together and apart as class, confidence and misunderstanding shape their lives.

mentions.author: George Eliot
mentions.note: (epigraph) It is one of the secrets in that change of mental poise which has been fitly named conversion, that to many among us neither heaven nor earth has any revelation till some personality touches theirs with a peculiar influence, subduing them into receptiveness. George Eliot, Daniel Deronda

mentions.author: Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels
mentions.note: He told her she should try reading The Communist Manifesto, he thought she would like it, and he offered to write down the title for her so she wouldn’t forget.

mentions.author: James Baldwin
mentions.note: He followed her into the study last week while she was looking for a copy of The Fire Next Time to lend him.

mentions.author: Doris Lessing
mentions.note: I’ve read The Golden Notebook, he could tell them. It’s true, he has read it.

mentions.author: Jane Austen
mentions.note: One night the library started closing just as he reached the passage in Emma when it seems like Mr Knightley is going to marry Harriet, and he had to close the book and walk home in a state of strange emotional agitation.

mentions.author: Marcel Proust
mentions.note: The copy of Swann’s Way she reads at lunchtime in the school cafeteria, with a dark French painting on the cover and a mint-coloured spine.

mentions.author: Frank O'Hara
mentions.note: for Marianne, an edition of Frank O’Hara’s selected poems he found in an English-language bookshop in Berlin.
